author: A former resident of Winterhold
pages:
#The City That Was

Winterhold was once the rival of Solitude: a great city of stone and learning on the cliffs of the Sea of Ghosts. My grandmother remembered streets where now there is only sea.

One night, called the Great Collapse, most of it slid into the water. Only the College on its rock stayed standing.

#The Blame

The townsfolk blame the College. The College says it saved what it could. The truth is buried under the sea with the rest.

The College still stands across its long bridge, and people in the town still spit when they look at it. It is the only thing they have left to be angry at.
